name: bring-up
description: Bring a Solana perp market up from zero. Walk through every account the on-chain program needs to operate: the Market header (allocate → initialize), the per-market PDA (create-market), and the per-(market, mint) vault PDA (create-vault). End with a deposit to confirm the vault works. This scenario is the minimum needed before any of the trading / liquidation / funding scenarios make sense.
headline: Stand up a fresh perp market on local-validator: 5 instructions, ~50 KCU total.

steps.explanation: Allocate a raw Market account. Pure SystemProgram::CreateAccount; no openhl-core invocation yet.
Initialize the allocated Market in place. First call into openhl-core's `Initialize` instruction; writes the discriminator + initial state.
Derive + create the per-market PDA via `invoke_signed`. PDA seeds are `["market", market.key]`. This is what most subsequent instructions sign against.
Allocate the per-(market, mint) collateral vault PDA. Seeds: `["vault", market, mint]`.
Deposit collateral into the vault via CPI to SPL Token. Demonstrates the CPI permission pattern and shows the vault accepting funds.
